title: C++: Simple Compiler (Simulated)
description: Build a simple expression compiler that tokenizes, parses, and evaluates arithmetic expressions.

steps.title: Tokenize Expression
steps.description: Tokenize '3 + 4 * 2' into tokens: NUMBER(3), OPERATOR(+), NUMBER(4), OPERATOR(*), NUMBER(2). Print each token with its type.
hints: Skip whitespace. Collect digits for numbers. Recognize +, -, *, /.
